component.name: Characters
Caractères
component.summary: Parcourir et rechercher des caractères Unicode

description.p: Browse Unicode characters, emoji, symbols, scripts, Unicode blocks, and named sequences. Search by name, keyword, alias, literal character, or code point, and inspect each selected character or sequence. View properties, encodings, normalization, and related characters, and copy the original text or a metadata report. Browse installed fonts, compare mapped characters across faces, and inspect legacy byte mappings. Choose supported emoji variations and search multilingual emoji annotations. Assemble characters in a native text editor, copy exact text or numeric representations, and explicitly normalize or inspect the composition. Save favorite characters and sequences, browse recent and frequent usage, and customize privacy, sidebar categories, and glyph preview sizes.
